Kartik Aaryan offers National Award to Lalbaugcha Raja

Actor Kartik Aaryan, who received the Best Actor award at the 72nd National Awards, visited the Lalbaugcha Raja temple in Mumbai. He offered his newly won award at the feet of Lord Ganesha. Aaryan traveled directly from Ekta Nagar in Gujarat to the temple.
